احتميا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَيَا (iḥtamayā) /iħ.ta.ma.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# اُحْتُمِيَا (uḥtumiyā) /uħ.tu.mi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# اِحْتَمِيَا (iḥtamiyā) /iħ.ta.mi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
